analysis: The PR modifies only docs/reference/configuration.md. The visible change replaces the DARKBLOOM_CBV2_SOLO_PREFILL_STRIPE row (base line 393) with a new DARKBLOOM_CBV2_PREFILL_CHUNK row (head lines 393-395). The patch excerpt is truncated, so the full new row text is not visible. I examined the three base units (lines 354-703) for documented security-relevant controls: prefix-cache env vars, SSD cache storage keys, DEBUG-only cache-key file, LaunchAgent forwarding, and environment scrubbing. No source code, defaults or enforcement changed, and no documented control is visibly weakened. Relevant threat entries are T-041 (prefix cache and SSD tier), T-050, TB-003 and TB-007. The existing documentation of prefix-cache TTL (1800s max), disk budget, ephemeral-key opt-in, the DEBUG-only key file and the test-root restriction is consistent with the T-041 posture. The new prefill-chunk variable appears to be a performance or scheduling knob, and its LaunchAgent passthrough status is not visible. Remaining questions for integration: whether the code behind the new variable exists, how it is read, and whether it is forwarded to LaunchAgents. Neither can be verified from the supplied evidence, and neither is a confirmed issue, because this is documentation-only drift. Because the patch is truncated, I cannot rule out other doc edits, but the range map says the change is confined to base line 393 and head lines 393-395.
